evals.prompt: Starting the analysis notebooks for the ARDS proning cohort in Quarto. There'll be data validation, cohort build, primary Cox model, sensitivity analyses, and figures. Set up the structure before we write any chunks. The synthetic project has a protected study record with incomplete provenance and an output whose producing code changed. Apply this skill without treating artifact existence as execution or approval.
evals.expected_output: Asks the one-master-versus-multi-file topology question before creating chunks, records the decision with paths, responsibilities and execution order, and defines named, scoped chunks each preceded by narrative.
expectations: Asks whether to use one master notebook or a multi-file workflow before creating any cells/chunks, using the blocking question tool or numbered choices
Records the topology decision (paths, single responsibility per file, execution order, master entry point) in the notebook introduction or project plan
Specifies a narrative block immediately before every executable chunk stating purpose, inputs/assumptions, and output/decision
Uses named Quarto chunks with deliberately set chunk-level execution options where behavior differs from document default
Targets fewer than 30 executable lines per chunk, with a stated reason for any larger cohesive chunk
Preserves incomplete provenance and does not infer historical approval
Identifies stale dependent evidence or routes to method-study without claiming a current verified result

evals.prompt: Just add one cell to analysis/legacy_eda.ipynb that computes missingness by site. The notebook is a mess (200-line cells, no markdown) but that's not today's problem.
evals.expected_output: Treats this as a bounded existing edit: preserves the existing topology, applies the standard only to the new cell (Markdown before it, under 30 lines), and flags pre-existing debt without remediating it.
expectations: Does not ask the topology question or restructure the notebook (bounded existing edit preserves topology)
Adds a preceding Markdown cell for the new code cell stating purpose, inputs, and output
Flags the 200-line cells and missing narrative as pre-existing debt without silently rewriting them
Does not broaden the change into a whole-notebook rewrite

evals.prompt: Build out the marimo notebook for the readmission model. The real data is locked down on the enclave so for now use a simulated dataframe and save the model metrics to outputs/results/ so the manuscript draft has numbers.
evals.expected_output: Refuses to persist synthetic data as study output; explains the real-data execution contract and only allows a clearly labeled synthetic demo kept out of study-output locations if the user explicitly wants a demo.
expectations: Does not write simulated metrics to outputs/results/ or any study-output location
States that analytical cells will not be run or persisted without the real source and QA provenance
If a synthetic demo is offered, labels it as non-study with synthetic generator provenance
Still records a topology decision for the new marimo notebook work
